OUR APPROACH

Every product passes the same test.

Before anything is built, we ask four questions: does it avoid harm, does it deal fairly, does it actually make life better, and does it respect the earth we're borrowing. If an idea can't answer yes to all four, it doesn't become a Deen System app.

Halal by design

No interest-based finance, no haram content, no dark patterns built to exploit attention. Principles are checked before a line of code is written, not patched in afterward.

Built for real benefit

Every app has to solve a genuine problem — a habit to break, a decision to make, a connection worth having. Engagement is a side effect of usefulness, never the goal itself.

Humanity-first

Your data isn't the product. We design for privacy by default and build features people actually need — shaped by real feedback from real people, because serving humanity matters more than growth metrics.

Earth as a trust

The Qur'an calls us stewards of the earth, not its owners. We build lightweight, efficient products, avoid unnecessary waste in how we design and host them, and treat environmental harm as a real cost — not something to look past for growth.

HOW DEEN SYSTEM WORKS

Vet. Build. Launch. Repeat.

Every app under the Deen System name goes through the same three-stage process before it reaches you.

01

Vet against principle

Every idea is measured against clear halal standards — no riba, no haram content, no exploitative design — before any design work starts.

02

Build with real care

The same rigour as any modern product: thoughtful design, real usability testing, and privacy by default, not as an afterthought.

03

Launch, listen, improve

Each app ships in stages, grows from community feedback, and connects into the same Deen System foundation over time.

TRUST & TRANSPARENCY

Terms & privacy, kept plain.

Our terms and privacy commitments, written the way we'd want them written for us — alongside the halal principles of amanah (trust) and adl (fairness) that shape everything else on this site.

Terms of ServiceLast updated October 2026 ⌄

1. Agreement to these terms

By visiting deensystem.com or using any Deen System app — No Haram, Deen System Economics, or any future product we launch under the Deen System name — you agree to these Terms of Service. We kindly ask that you use our products only if you're comfortable agreeing to these terms.

2. Who we are

Deen System is a platform building a family of apps and websites designed around Islamic ethical principles, for anyone who wants technology that avoids harm and deals fairly — regardless of faith background. These Terms of Service are the master agreement for the whole Deen System platform: they apply to this website and to every app or product we release now or in the future under the Deen System name, and if a specific product ever needs its own additional terms, those will supplement this agreement rather than replace it. No Haram and Deen System Economics are now available, and our other apps are still in development; this website shares our progress and introduces each product.

3. Our halal commitment isn't a religious ruling

We design every Deen System product to avoid interest-based (riba) financial structures, haram content, and manipulative "dark pattern" design. This is a product design commitment we hold ourselves to — it is not a fatwa or formal Islamic legal ruling, and it doesn't replace independent religious guidance. If you need an authoritative ruling on whether a specific feature is appropriate for your own practice, please consult a qualified Islamic scholar.

4. Our environmental commitment

We treat the earth as an amanah — a trust, not a resource to use up. We aim to build lightweight, efficient products, avoid unnecessary waste in how we design and host our services, and choose vendors and infrastructure with a lower environmental footprint where it's practical to do so. This is a standing commitment we hold ourselves to; it does not create a guarantee about the environmental impact of any specific feature, and we'll be upfront when a trade-off is genuinely difficult.

5. Who can use our products

You must be able to form a binding contract in your jurisdiction to use Deen System products, and you must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum digital consent age where you live, if higher). If a specific app is intended for a different minimum age, that app's own terms will say so.

6. Acceptable use

When using Deen System products, you agree not to:

  • Break the law, or use our products for anything illegal.
  • Harm, harass, or exploit other users.
  • Upload or share haram, illegal, or harmful content.
  • Attempt to interfere with, hack, or disrupt our systems.
  • Misrepresent your identity.
  • Copy our products to build a competing service without permission.

7. Deen System Economics and other financial or legal-awareness content — not advice

Deen System Economics, and any financial or legal-awareness content across Deen System products, is provided for general education only. It is not personalised financial, investment, tax, legal, or Shariah-compliance advice, and it is not a substitute for a licensed financial advisor, a qualified lawyer, or a qualified Islamic finance scholar. Halal-share and halal-asset screens, and our scam and fraud awareness content, are decision-support and educational tools, not guarantees — always verify significant financial or legal decisions independently, and report suspected fraud to the relevant authorities in your jurisdiction.

8. Accounts

Once our apps launch, some may require an account. You're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for activity under your account. Tell us right away if you think your account has been compromised.

9. Intellectual property

The Deen System name, logo, app names, and the content on this website belong to Deen System (or its licensors). You may not copy, resell, or redistribute them without our written permission. Anything you create or upload using our products remains yours — we don't claim ownership of your content.

10. Products in development, provided "as is"

Some Deen System apps are now available and others are still in development. Features, pricing, names, and availability described on this site may change before launch. This website and our products are provided "as is," without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent the law allows.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Deen System, its team, and its licensors are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of data, revenue, or goodwill, arising from your use of — or inability to use — our website or products. As explained in our Privacy Policy, we don't collect, store, or process your personal data, contact lists, or any other private information through this website, so there is nothing meaningful on our end for a breach to expose. You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold Deen System and its team harmless from any claim, loss, or expense — including reasonable legal fees — arising from your misuse of our products, your violation of these terms, or your violation of any law or third-party right.

17. International users and your rights

Deen System can be used from anywhere, and we try to hold ourselves to good privacy practice no matter where you're located — including the spirit of major frameworks like the EU's GDPR and California's CCPA/CPRA: we collect only what we need, we never sell your personal data, and you stay in control of what you share with us (see our Privacy Policy). We don't claim formal certification under any specific country's law, since that will depend on each app's details once it launches. If the mandatory consumer-protection or data-protection laws of your own country give you rights that these Terms could otherwise limit, those local rights still apply to you, and the rest of these Terms remains in effect.

Deen System products are open to anyone who meets the eligibility requirements in Section 5, regardless of race, nationality, gender, disability, or faith background. If something's wrong, please email us first at meet@deensystem.com — most concerns can be sorted out quickly and informally, and we'd always rather fix a problem directly with you than end up in a dispute. If any part of these terms turns out to be unenforceable, the rest stays in effect. These terms, together with our Privacy Policy, are the entire agreement between you and Deen System about your use of our products, and they replace any earlier versions. 21. Advertising

To help cover the cost of research, development, and keeping our products running, some Deen System apps and websites may show small banner ads — served either by Google (for example through AdMob or AdSense) or by Deen System itself, such as a banner about another Deen System product. Ads will stay small and respectful: no pop-ups, full-screen interruptions, auto-playing video, or ads designed to trick you into tapping. We filter out ad categories that conflict with our halal commitment, such as gambling, alcohol, interest-based (riba) lending, and adult or dating content; because third-party networks choose ads automatically, an unsuitable ad may occasionally slip through — if you see one, email meet@deensystem.com and we'll block it. We never sell or share your personal data with advertisers. To deliver an ad, count views, and prevent fraud, Google may process limited technical information — such as your device type, approximate location from your IP address, or your device's advertising ID — under Google's own privacy policy. Wherever possible we request non-personalised ads, and where the law requires it we'll ask for your consent before any personalised ads are shown. You can reset or limit your advertising ID at any time in your device settings. An ad is not an endorsement: any purchase you make from an advertiser is between you and that advertiser.

Privacy PolicyLast updated October 2026 ⌄

1. Our approach to your data — amanah

We treat your data as an amanah — a trust — not a product to sell. That's true today, while this is a simple pre-launch website, and it will stay true once our apps are live. We hold the same trust toward the earth: we only keep the data we actually need, which keeps what we run leaner and lighter on the infrastructure behind it too.

2. What this website collects today

This website does not run its own server or database, and it doesn't have any form that collects information from you. The "Contact" links on this site simply open your own email app with our address already filled in — nothing is sent to us through this page itself. We don't use cookies or analytics trackers on this site as of this update. This site only saves one small setting in your own browser — your language choice — so you don't have to pick it again; it never leaves your device.

3. If that changes

If we ever add analytics, cookies, or account features to this website or our apps, we'll update this policy first and describe clearly what's collected, why, and how you can opt out.

4. What our apps will collect, once launched

Each Deen System app will publish its own, more specific privacy details when it launches, covering things like account information, usage data needed to run the app, and — where relevant, like Deen System Economics — financial information you choose to enter. We'll only collect what a feature actually needs to work. When we do collect data, we'll apply the same privacy-first principles described in this policy — including never selling your data — consistent with the spirit of major privacy laws like the GDPR and CCPA, no matter where in the world you're using our products. Some free apps may also show small banner ads to help fund development — Section 21 of our Terms of Service explains how those ads work and what limited technical information an ad provider such as Google may process.

5. What we will never do

  • Sell, rent, or trade your personal data to advertisers, data brokers, or any other third party.
  • Use your data to serve interest-based (riba) financial products.
  • Build engagement-maximising profiles designed to exploit your attention.

If a future partner or integration would ever require an exception, we'll ask for your clear, opt-in consent first — never a buried default.

6. Children's privacy

Our website and current pre-launch content are not directed at children under 13. If a future Deen System app is designed for a younger audience, that app's own privacy policy will explain the extra protections in place.

7. Your rights

You can ask us what data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, by emailing meet@deensystem.com. Once our apps launch, in-app settings will offer the same controls directly.

8. Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect any information you share with us. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, but we take this seriously and will disclose any significant data incident that affects you.

9. Changes to this policy

We'll update the date above whenever this policy changes, and for meaningful changes, we'll make a reasonable effort to let you know.

10. Contact

Questions about your data? Email meet@deensystem.com.
